title: Dependency installs honour pins, run one at a time per environment, and new projects do not inherit packages
user_story: As the owner I want an experiment's environment to contain exactly what its requirements pin, so measured results are reproducible (live run 2026-10-28: matplotlib 3.11.2 for a 3.9.2 pin, torch cu124 for a +cpu pin, two concurrent installs, an inheriting venv; agent/PLAN_6.6.4_L3.md A4).

requirements.description: A package named in a requirements file is never installed unpinned by the import fallback after its pinned install fails; local-version pins (+cpu, +cuNNN) use the matching PyTorch index.
One dependency install per environment at a time: a second install waits (default up to 30 min, then exits 4 with a message); a lock older than 1 h is taken over; the lock is released at exit.
A new code project's environment does not include the interpreter's site-packages; an explicit setting and existing projects keep their choice.

nonfunctional: Offline behaviour unchanged when everything is satisfied
Lock kept in the temp folder, keyed by the environment path
outputs: pip commands and their results; exit code 3 (not installed) or 4 (locked)
postconditions: No package is silently installed at a version other than its pin
acceptance_criteria: test_envs_deps, code project, sandbox, runs and CLI suites pass

scenarios.expected: Imports outside the requirements are still installed
A failed pinned requirement is reported, never replaced by an unpinned install
+cpu and +cu124 pins use the matching PyTorch index; plain pins do not
A held lock makes the second install wait then exit 4; a stale lock is taken over
A new project's venv is created without --system-site-packages
An explicit inherit choice is kept
An uncontended install takes and releases the lock without waiting

recovery: Fix at deps.ENSURE / code_projects.create; never install a pinned package unpinned or share an install across concurrent runs. TASK-DEPS-PINS-664, max three cycles.
test_environment: The real generated ensure_deps.py run offline (PIP_NO_INDEX) with a temporary lock path; disposable PHDLAB_DATA_DIR for code projects (tests/_env.py); evidence in docs/qa/evidence/deps-pins-664/.

tdd.scope: RED: 7 tests on 13000d6, 4 failing (unpinned replacement, no index for local versions, no lock, inherited packages); the explicit-choice, lock-release and other-imports checks pass on both. GREEN: 7/7.
